about: IN-10 · the Insights golden index (docs/insights/modules/IN-10-verification/CLAUDE.md). One suite per module golden list. `status` is `skip` (with `waits_on`) until the module that builds it switches it to `run` and adds its group to ci/api/tests/in-10-golden.test.cjs (fixture ci/fixtures/in-company). Expected figures are worked by hand, never read back from the engine. IN-10 final: every suite runs.
